body: Nuveen Churchill Direct Lending Corp. reported third-quarter 2026 investment income of $43.7 million, down 14.6% from $51.1 million a year earlier. Net increase in net assets from operations was $16 million, and diluted earnings per share was $0.32, both lower than in the prior-year quarter.Financial HighlightsInvestment income was $43.7M, compared with $51.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (14.6%).Net increase in net assets from operations was $16.0M, compared with $18.7M; YoY change (14.3%).Diluted EPS was $0.32, compared with $0.38; YoY change (15.8%).Business HighlightsNine-month commitments increased to $308.2 million from $243.2 million. The portfolio ended September with 258 companies across 27 industries.The company formed Senior Loan Fund I with an institutional partner and transferred $148.9 million of first-lien loans into the vehicle.Credit quality weakened, with the weighted-average risk rating rising to 4.4 from 4.2 and nine companies on non-accrual, compared with four at year-end 2025.Management said deal activity improved modestly in the third quarter but remained selective, and is monitoring tariff, geopolitical, interest-rate and AI-related risks.Original SEC Filing: Nuveen Churchill Direct Lending Corp.
